title: 第3章 狂放霸道
content_zh:
清晨的林家显得格外的热闹，因为要召开族会，林家之人俱都朝着位于林府中央的演武场走去。

“听说了吗，这次族会不仅大爷、三爷回来了，大长老也来了，看来是冲着家主去的。”

“呵呵，虽说族长实力强大，但他那废物儿子说不定已经死去，还被云海宗的人亲自送回来，丢尽了我们林家的脸，大爷本就一直对族长不满，这次哪里能不发难，说不定我们林家要易主了。”

路途中，有林家之人窃窃私语，人群似乎都知道今天的族会非比寻常。

林枫和林海此刻也在前往中央演武场的路途，见到林枫安然无恙，许多人的眼中不由得闪过了一抹异色，甚至有人心中想着这废物怎么没死，不过摄于林海的威严，大部分人都不敢说出心中想法。

“这废物真是命大，竟然还没死。”突然，一道刺耳的声音传出，让许多人目光一滞，抬头看去，就见到一行人气势不凡的朝着这边走来。

开口之人是一少年，林家老三林浩然的儿子林云，和林枫都是十五岁年龄，不过却是气武境六重武修。

“原来是林云，难怪敢这么说了。”人群见到三爷林浩然和大爷林霸道走在一块顿时心头凛然，来者不善啊。

“你再说一遍。”林海眼中冷光一闪，眼眸直视林云，让林云目光微痛，不敢正视林海。

“老二，你这家主真是越来越不像话了，连晚辈都欺负。”林霸道嘲讽一声，语气冷淡。

“哼，我林海好歹是一家之主，林云如此没有教养，成何体统。”林海冷漠回应。

“二哥真是好威风，不过我倒想要看看你这族长能威风到几时。”林浩然语气刻薄：“你那废物儿子，被云海宗的人抬回林家，丢进我林家脸面，难道还不让人说。”

“我威风不到几时？林浩然，你意思是我这家主当不了多久了，难道你想当，你以为，你够资格？”林海脚步一跨，浑身散发着冰冷的气息，跟在林浩然身边的林云只觉浑身冰凉，躲到了林浩然的后面。

“够不够资格由众位长老说了算，不是你林海说了算。”林浩然的脸色阴沉了下来，没想到林海今日一反常态，如此霸道。

“这么说你承认了，那好，我林海现在还是家主，你儿子在我面前诅咒我这家主的儿子死，该当何罪。”

林海丝毫不退让，寒气越来越盛，这一片的空间温度都下降了许多，甚至隐隐有白色的冰霜浮现。

“家主不愧为家主，身上自带威严，竟然率先向三爷发难。”人群的目光都朝着这边看来，心中隐隐有一丝钦佩，他们还以为林海会被动应付大爷和三爷的发难。

“林海，你莫非以为我怕了你不成。”林浩然今日有备而来，话音落下，一股强大的热气扑出，和寒冰相抗。

“父亲拥有冰魄武魂，因此主修寒冰功法，而林浩然拥有的火焰武魂，修炼火焰功法，水克火，即便修为相当林浩然也不会是父亲的对手，这次的主角显然不是他。”

一旁的林枫目光朝着旁边的林霸道看去，只见林霸道嘴角露出一抹邪异的冷笑，随即说道：“老二，族会马上就要开始，你这家主莫非连长老团都不放在眼里了。”

在林家，长老团高于一切，是为了制约家主而存在，因此林霸道用长老团来压林海，给林海扣上一顶大帽。

“哼。”林海不屑的扫了林浩然一眼，随即收回气息，和林枫一块离开。

林浩然自然察觉到了林海的不屑，眼眸中射出道道冷光，这次你那废物儿子走运没死，下次就不会这么便宜了。

林浩然的大儿子林恒乃是云海宗外门子弟佼佼者，迟早成为内门子弟，甚至是核心子弟，父凭子贵，那时候他的身份自然也水涨船高，不是林家一个家主能够比得上的。

而林霸道的女儿林芊更是天赋异禀，如今已经是皓月宗内门子弟，将来的成就不可限量，三兄弟中唯独林海的儿子资质极差，被人称为废物，这正是林霸道和林浩然的凭仗，如今长老团也向着他们，这就是大势，而林海，是在逆势而为。

巨大的演武场，林家四五百人全部汇聚于此，在演武场的中央有着一青石高台，此刻林家的掌权之人就都在上面。

“众位长老，前几日云海宗之人来到我们林家，本来是荣幸之事，却不想竟送来一半死不活的废物，丢尽了我林家脸面，因此我建议将林枫逐出家族，他不配当我林家子弟。”

林浩然站起身来，对着长老席上的众位长老拱手说道，直接发难。

“你倒是很爽快，开门见山，不过，我这一家之主还没开口，什么时候轮到你老三指手画脚了，滚回你的位置。”林海当然清楚林浩然的目的，极为强势，他倒要看看，对方想怎么将他儿子逐出家族，然后夺他家主之位。

“老二，你这么说就不对了，虽说你是家主，但老三也算是家族掌舵人之一，乃是为了我林家着想，你那废物儿子着实丢我林家脸面，该逐出家族。”林霸道阴测测的声音响起，一起攻击林海。

“我的儿子我自己会管，与家族何干，更轮不到你们来管，林霸道，我知道你一直觊觎我的位置，这样，今日你我便战一场，你若胜我，我带着我儿子一起离开林家，你若败的话……就少给我放屁。”

林海站起身来，脚步跨出，直接来到高台中央，强大的气息绽放，遥指林霸道，你不战，也得战。

林枫看着自己的父亲一改常态，咄咄*人，心中雪亮，大陆武道为尊，只有实力强大者才有话语权，他是想用自己的实力让对方闭嘴。

“我怕你不成。”林霸道听到林海竟辱骂他放屁，怒意滋生，起身跨步，与林海相对而立。

众位长老都保持着沉默，他们都乐于看到这种局面，若是林海连林霸道都胜不了，又拥有一个废物儿子，林家家主之位，自然要挪动一下了。

“我倒要看看你凭什么这么狂。”林霸道冷笑一声，却见林海丝毫不跟他废话，寒冰之意笼罩高台，林家几百之众，在同一瞬间感觉到了刺骨的寒冷，冷入骨髓。

这就是武魂的力量，林海的武魂乃是冰魄武魂，一经释放，周围尽皆化为被寒冰侵蚀。

“冰封千里。”林霸道刚想要释放自己的武魂，却听林海大声喝道，随即咔嚓的声响传出，以林海为中心，寒冰覆盖高台，朝着周围扩散，整个高台上都附上雪白的寒冰，而林霸道也在这一刻，成为了一具冰人，被冰封在了寒冰当中。

“轰！”一声爆响，冰雪碎裂，只见林霸道身体直接飞了出去，嘴中喷出一口血箭，随即重重的跌落。

众位长老站起身来，震惊的看着眼前的一幕，林霸道，竟不堪一击。

“冰封千里，林海的冰封决竟修炼到了第八重，难怪如此强势。”大长老目光闪烁，林海拥有冰魄武魂，再加上强大的冰封决，瞬间将林霸道冰封，然后一击必杀，一气呵成，林霸道连反应时间都没有，只要林海再慢上半拍，恐怕就别想如此轻松。

林家众人目光显得有些呆滞，他们第一次见到如此霸道的林海，比大爷林霸道更霸道十分。

林霸道又吐出一口鲜血，目光阴厉的看着林海，不过林海却毫不在意，他当然能够猜到林枫受伤和他这两位兄弟脱不了干系，既然他们都要杀他的儿子，他林海哪里还需要顾及兄弟之情。

“众位长老，继续族会吧。”林海袍袖一挥，回到自己的座位，仿佛什么事都没有做。

“呵呵，林海，你作为一家之主，修为更进一步，做好了表率，我相信我林家子弟都会奋发苦修，这族会的目的也达到了，大家都散了吧。”大长老淡淡一笑，此刻再继续族会已经毫无意义可言。

“大长老，既然如此，我就先告退了。”林枫对着大长老拱了拱手，和林枫一块起身。

“林海，我倒想要看看，你能护这废物多久。”林浩然见目的没有达到，冷冷的说了一声。

“就是，废物，我林家的耻辱。”林云附和出声，不过见到林海目光扫来，顿时又闭上了嘴。

“小枫，我们走吧。”林海不愿再理对方，不过林枫却并没有走，而是转过身，抬起脚步，朝着林云的方向而去，这一幕让人群神色一凝，不知道林枫想要做什么。

林海也诧异的看着自己的儿子，只见林枫走到林云身前不远处，然后看着林云道：“林云，你张口闭口说我废物，我想问问，如果哪天你发现你比我更不堪，你自己如何下得了台？”

“你是在做梦吗，你这废物能和我比。”林云没想到林枫这废物都敢这样和他说话，不由得嘲讽一声。

林枫眼眸闪烁，随即轻笑了下，淡漠说道：“林云，我林枫，向你发出挑战。”
content_en:
The Lin family was particularly lively in the early morning, because a clan meeting was about to be held, and everyone in the Lin family was walking towards the martial arts field in the center of the Lin Mansion.

"Have you heard that not only the eldest and third masters are back at this clan meeting, but the eldest elder is also here. It seems that they are going to the head of the family."

"Haha, although the clan leader is powerful, his good-for-nothing son may have died and been sent back by the Yunhai Sect himself, which has brought shame on our Lin family. The uncle has always been dissatisfied with the clan leader. How can we not make trouble this time? Our Lin family may change owners."

On the way, people from the Lin family were whispering, and the crowd seemed to know that today's clan meeting was unusual.

Lin Feng and Lin Hai were also on their way to the central martial arts arena at this moment. Seeing Lin Feng safe and sound, many people couldn't help but have a strange look in their eyes. Some even thought about why this waste was not dead. However, due to Lin Hai's majesty, most people did not dare to express their thoughts.

"This loser is really lucky, and he's not dead yet." Suddenly, a harsh voice came out, causing many people to freeze their eyes. When they looked up, they saw a group of people walking towards this side with extraordinary momentum.

The person who spoke was a young man, Lin Yun, the son of Lin Haoran, the eldest son of the Lin family. He and Lin Feng were both fifteen years old, but he was a martial artist at the sixth level of the Qi Martial Realm.

"It turns out to be Lin Yun, no wonder he dared to say that." When the crowd saw the third master Lin Haoran and the eldest master Lin Badao walking together, they suddenly felt awe-struck. They came with bad intentions.

"Say it again." Lin Hai's eyes flashed coldly, and he looked directly at Lin Yun, which made Lin Yun's eyes hurt slightly and he did not dare to look directly at Lin Hai.

"Second brother, the head of your family is getting more and more outrageous. You even bully the juniors." Lin Badao sneered, his tone cold.

"Hmph, I, Lin Hai, am the head of the family after all. How can Lin Yun be so uneducated?" Lin Hai responded coldly.

"Second brother is so majestic, but I want to see how long you, the leader of the clan, can be so majestic." Lin Haoran said in a harsh tone: "Your good-for-nothing son was carried back to the Lin family by the Yunhai Sect and thrown into the face of my Lin family. Why don't you let people talk about it?"

"How long will my prestige last? Lin Haoran, you mean that I won't be the head of the family for long. Do you want to be the head of the family? Do you think you are qualified?" Lin Hai took a step forward, exuding a cold aura. Lin Yun, who was following Lin Haoran, felt his whole body was cold and hid behind Lin Haoran.

"The elders have the final say on whether they are qualified or not, not you, Lin Hai." Lin Haoran's face darkened. He didn't expect Lin Hai to be so domineering today, uncharacteristically.

"So you admit it. Well, I, Lin Hai, am still the head of the family. What crime should your son be guilty of cursing the son of the head of the family to death in front of me?"

Lin Hai did not give in at all, the cold air became stronger and stronger, the temperature of this space dropped a lot, and even white frost appeared faintly.

"The head of the house is worthy of being the head of the house. He carries his own majesty, and he actually took the lead in attacking the third master." The crowd looked here, with a hint of admiration in their hearts. They thought that Lin Hai would passively deal with the attack by the uncle and the third master.

"Lin Hai, do you think I'm afraid of you?" Lin Haoran came prepared today. As soon as he finished speaking, a powerful burst of hot air rushed out to fight against the ice.

"My father possesses the Ice Soul Martial Arts, so he specializes in ice techniques, while Lin Haoran possesses the Fire Martial Soul, which practices fire techniques and can defeat fire with water. Even if his cultivation level is comparable, Lin Haoran will not be his father's opponent. The protagonist this time is obviously not him."

Lin Feng, who was standing beside him, looked at Lin Ba Dao, and saw an evil sneer on Lin Ba Dao's lips, and then said: "Second brother, the clan meeting is about to start. Could it be that you, the head of the family, don't even pay attention to the elders?"

In the Lin family, the elders group is above all else and exists to restrict the family head. Therefore, Lin Badao uses the elders group to suppress Lin Hai and put a big hat on Lin Hai.

"Hmph." Lin Hai glanced at Lin Haoran with disdain, then took back his breath and left with Lin Feng.

Lin Haoran naturally noticed Lin Hai's disdain, and there was a cold light in his eyes. Your good-for-nothing son was lucky enough not to die this time, and he won't be so cheap next time.

Lin Haoran's eldest son, Lin Hengnai, was a leader among the outer disciples of the Yunhai Sect. Sooner or later he would become an inner disciple, or even a core disciple. The father was more valuable than the son. At that time, his status was naturally rising, and not one head of the Lin family could match him.

Lin Ba Dao's daughter Lin Qian is even more talented. Now she is a disciple of the Haoyue Sect, and her future achievements are limitless. Among the three brothers, only Lin Hai's son has extremely poor qualifications and is called a waste. This is what Lin Ba Dao and Lin Haoran rely on. Now the elders are also moving towards them. This is the general trend, and Lin Hai is bucking the trend.

In the huge martial arts arena, all four to five hundred people from the Lin family gathered here. In the center of the martial arts arena was a bluestone high platform, and the powerful people of the Lin family were on it at the moment.

"Elders, it was an honor for people from the Yunhai Sect to come to our Lin family a few days ago, but unexpectedly they sent half of them dead trash, which brought shame to our Lin family. Therefore, I suggest that Lin Feng be expelled from the family. He is not worthy to be a child of my Lin family."

Lin Haoran stood up, raised his hands to the elders at the elders' table, and directly attacked them.

"You are very straightforward and straight to the point. However, the head of the family hasn't opened my mouth yet. When will it be your turn to tell the truth? Go back to your position." Of course Lin Hai knew Lin Haoran's purpose, which was extremely strong. He wanted to see how the other party wanted to expel his son from the family and then seize his position as head of the family.

"Second brother, what you said is wrong. Although you are the head of the family, the third child is also one of the leaders of the family. This is for the sake of my Lin family. Your good-for-nothing son has really disgraced my Lin family and should be expelled from the family." Lin Badao's sinister voice sounded, and they attacked Lin Hai together.

"I can take care of my son myself. It has nothing to do with the family, and it's not your turn to take care of it. Lin Badao, I know you have always coveted my position. So, today you and I will have a fight. If you win, I will take my son and leave the Lin family together. If you lose... stop giving me shit."

Lin Hai stood up, stepped out, and came directly to the center of the high platform. A powerful aura bloomed, pointing at Lin Badao from a distance, "If you don't want to fight, you have to fight."

Lin Feng watched his father change from his normal behavior and become aggressive, and he felt clear in his heart that mainland martial arts were respected and only the powerful had the right to speak. He wanted to use his own strength to silence the other party.

"I'm afraid you won't succeed." Lin Badao became angry when he heard that Lin Hai insulted him for farting. He stood up and stepped forward to stand opposite Lin Hai.

All the elders remained silent. They were all happy to see this situation. If Lin Hai could not defeat even Lin Ba Dao and had a useless son, his position as the head of the Lin family would naturally be moved.

"I want to see why you are so crazy." Lin Badao sneered, but saw that Lin Hai didn't talk nonsense to him at all. The ice covered the high platform, and hundreds of people in the Lin family felt the biting cold at the same moment, cold to the bone.

This is the power of martial arts. Lin Hai's martial soul is the ice soul martial soul. Once released, everything around him will be eroded by ice.

"Fixed for thousands of miles." Lin Ba Dao just wanted to release his martial spirit, but heard Lin Hai shouting loudly, and then a cracking sound was heard. With Lin Hai as the center, ice covered the high platform and spread to the surroundings. The entire high platform was covered with snow-white ice. At this moment, Lin Ba Dao became an iceman and was frozen in the ice.

"Boom!" There was an explosion, the ice and snow shattered, and Lin Badao's body flew directly out, a blood arrow spurted out of his mouth, and then he fell heavily.

The elders stood up and looked at the scene in front of them in shock. Lin Badao was so vulnerable.

"Thousands of miles away, Lin Hai's Ice Art has been cultivated to the eighth level. No wonder he is so powerful." The elder's eyes flashed. Lin Hai possessed the Ice Soul Martial Spirit, coupled with the powerful Ice Art, he instantly froze Lin Badao, and then killed him with one strike. Lin Badao didn't even have time to react. As long as Lin Hai was half a beat slower, he might not be able to be so relaxed.

The eyes of everyone in the Lin family seemed a little dull. This was the first time they had seen such a domineering Lin Hai, even more domineering than their uncle Lin Ba Dao.

Lin Ba Dao spit out another mouthful of blood and looked at Lin Hai with a stern look, but Lin Hai didn't care. Of course, he could guess that Lin Feng's injury was closely related to his two brothers. Since they were going to kill his son, why did he, Lin Hai, need to take care of brotherhood.

"Elders, let's continue the clan meeting." Lin Hai waved his sleeves and returned to his seat, as if he had done nothing.

"Haha, Lin Hai, as the head of the family, you have made further progress in your cultivation and set an example. I believe that the children of my Lin family will work hard and practice hard. The purpose of this clan meeting has been achieved. Let's all disperse." The elder smiled faintly. It was meaningless to continue the clan meeting at this moment.

"Great Elder, in that case, I will take my leave first." Lin Feng bowed his hands to the Great Elder and stood up together with Lin Feng.

"Lin Hai, I want to see how long you can protect this waste." Lin Haoran said coldly when he saw that his goal was not achieved.

"That's right, trash, the shame of my Lin family." Lin Yun echoed, but when Lin Hai glanced at him, he immediately shut his mouth.

"Xiao Feng, let's go." Lin Hai did not want to pay attention to the other party, but Lin Feng did not leave. Instead, he turned around, raised his feet, and walked in the direction of Lin Yun. This scene made the crowd look at each other, wondering what Lin Feng wanted to do.

Lin Hai also looked at his son in surprise. He saw Lin Feng walking not far in front of Lin Yun, and then looked at Lin Yun and said: "Lin Yun, you keep calling me useless. I want to ask, if one day you find that you are worse than me, how can you get off the stage?"

"Are you dreaming? You loser can compare with me." Lin Yun didn't expect that loser Lin Feng would dare to talk to him like this, so he couldn't help but sneered.

Lin Feng's eyes flickered, then he chuckled and said indifferently: "Lin Yun, I, Lin Feng, challenge you."
